title: The House of the Spirits
author: Isabel Allende
current_text: The House of the Spirits was challenged in the Watauga County, N.C. High School curriculum in 2013 because of its graphic nature; after a five-month process, it was fully retained at a third and final appeal hearing. The House of the Spirits was challenged on the tenth grade reading list at La Costa Canyon High School in Encinitas, Calif., in 1999 because it allegedly “defames” the Catholic faith and contains “pornographic passages.” The House of the Spirits was challenged but retained in advanced English classes in Modesto, Calif., in 2003; the seven-member Modesto City School Board said administrators should give parents more information about the books their children read. The House of the Spirits was retained on summer reading lists for honors high school students at the Fairfield-Suisun Unified School District, Calif., in 2000 despite objections that it was “immoral and sexually depraved.”
